measures.name: relock_time_us
measures.note: the top cosim gate does not record this yet, so the msde release reads it missing and refuses until it does. Evidence today, not gate-read: blocks/pll/reports/recorded/cosim_cov.json (f_ref 5 MHz, N 1->3->2, gate level + SDF, 5 corners, no vctrl pad): last lock rise after a step 3.9-5.1 us, worst 15.1 us at ff_pss. ff_pss at N=3 (120 MHz, near its 125.6 ceiling) fails that bench's own at-end check: LOCK falls twice, vctrl overshoots to 3.5 V and still moves 229 mV p-p 20 us after the step, settling within 20 mV about 25 us after it (cosim_cov_cases.json). N=4 and N=5 steps and f_ref other than 5 MHz are not run
